question: Why does …6667, with 6s going on forever, equal 1/3?
answer: Multiplying the endless string …6667 by 3, one column at a time from the right, carries 2 at each step. The result is …0001, which equals 1. Three copies of the string make exactly 1, so the string is 1/3.
move: A number is 1/3 if three of it make 1, even with endless digits.
